title: Assessing the hepatotoxicity of PFOA, PFOS, and 6:2 Cl-PFESA in black-spotted frogs (Rana nigromaculata) and elucidating potential association with gut microbiota.
authors: Lin, Huikang; Wu, Haoying; Liu, Fangyi; Yang, Hongmei; Shen, Lilai; Chen, Jiahuan; Zhang, Xiaofang; Zhong, Yuchi; Zhang, Hangjun; Liu, Zhiquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PFAS对青蛙的肝毒性及肠道菌群关联，仅用分子对接辅助说明配体结合，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pollution caused by per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFASs) has become a major global concern. The association between PFAS-induced hepatotoxicity and gut microbiota in amphibians, particularly at environmentally relevant concentrations, remains elusive. Herein we exposed male black-spotted frogs (Rana nigromaculata) to 1 and 10 mug/L waterborne perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), perfluorooctanesulfonic acid (PFOS), and 6:2 chlorinated polyfluorinated ether sulfonate (6:2 Cl-PFESA) for 21 days; subsequently, liver histopathological, oxidative stress, molecular docking, gene/protein expression, and gut microbiome analyses were conducted. PFOS and 6:2 Cl-PFESA exposure enhanced serum alanine aminotransferase and aspartate aminotransferase activities, and markedly increased hepatic area of vacuoles and inflammatory cell infiltration, while PFOA exposure increased serum alanine aminotransferase but not aspartate aminotransferase activities and affected hepatic area of vacuoles and inflammatory cell infiltration to a lesser extent. All three PFASs elevated catalase, glutathione S-transferase, and glutathione peroxidase activities and glutathione and malondialdehyde contents in the liver, suggesting the induction of oxidative stress. Further, PFASs could bind to mitogen-activated protein kinases (p38, ERK, and JNK), upregulating not only their expression but also the expression of downstream oxidative stress-related genes and that of P-p38, P-ERK, and Nrf2 proteins. In addition, PFAS exposure significantly increased the relative abundance of Proteobacteria and Delftia and decreased that of Firmicutes and Dietzia, Mycoplasma, and Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum in the order of PFOS  approximately  6:2 Cl-PFESA > PFOA. Altogether, it appears that PFOS and 6:2 Cl-PFESA are more toxic than PFOA. Finally, microbiota function prediction, microbiota co-occurrence network, and correlation analysis between gut microbiota and liver indices suggested that PFAS-induced hepatotoxicity was associated with gut microbiota dysbiosis. Our data provide new insights into the role of gut microbiota in PFAS-induced hepatotoxicity in frogs.
abstract_zh: 全氟和多氟烷基物质（PFASs）造成的污染已成为全球重大关切问题。PFAS诱导的肝毒性与其在两栖动物中肠道微生物群之间的关联，尤其是在环境相关浓度下，仍不明确。本研究将雄性黑斑蛙（Rana nigromaculata）暴露于1和10 μg/L的水性全氟辛酸（PFOA）、全氟辛烷磺酸（PFOS）和6:2氯化多氟醚磺酸盐（6:2 Cl-PFESA）中21天；随后进行了肝脏组织病理学、氧化应激、分子对接、基因/蛋白表达及肠道微生物组分析。PFOS和6:2 Cl-PFESA暴露增强了血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶活性，并显著增加了肝空泡面积和炎症细胞浸润，而PFOA暴露仅增加了血清丙氨酸氨基转移酶而非天冬氨酸氨基转移酶活性，并对肝空泡面积和炎症细胞浸润的影响程度较小。所有三种PFASs均提高了肝脏中过氧化氢酶、谷胱甘肽S-转移酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性以及谷胱甘肽和丙二醛含量，表明诱导了氧化应激。此外，PFASs能与丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（p38、ERK和JNK）结合，不仅上调其表达，还上调下游氧化应激相关基因以及P-p38、P-ERK和Nrf2蛋白的表达。另外，PFAS暴露显著增加了变形菌门（Proteobacteria）和代尔夫特菌属（Delftia）的相对丰度，并降低了厚壁菌门（Firmicutes）以及Dietzia、支原体属（Mycoplasma）和甲基杆菌-甲基红杆菌属（Methylobacterium-Methylorubrum）的丰度，其顺序为PFOS ≈ 6:2 Cl-PFESA > PFOA。总体来看，PFOS和6:2 Cl-PFESA的毒性似乎高于PFOA。最后，微生物群功能预测、微生物群共现网络以及肠道微生物群与肝脏指标之间的相关性分析表明，PFAS诱导的肝毒性与肠道微生物群失调相关。我们的数据为肠道微生物群在蛙类PFAS诱导肝毒性中的作用提供了新见解。
